title: epan: Remove remaining uses of tvb_get_ptr with length -1
description:
tvb_get_ptr returns a bare pointer, so the caller always needs to
know the captured length somehow for safety reasons. Most of the
time, it's retrieved alongside the ptr already, so just use it.

It probably doesn't make a lot of sense to implement
tvb_get_ptr_remaining, unless that function also returns the
length in a pointer.
